name: nrf52840-promicro
description: V1940 ProMicro NRF52840, a nice!nano-compatible clone (1MB flash, 256KB SRAM), HSE 32MHz -> 64MHz. Ships the Adafruit nRF52 UF2 bootloader with SoftDevice S140 6.1.1, so the application runs at 0x26000 and is flashed as a UF2 via the bootloader mass-storage. No RGB LED (user LED on P1.10); console is the physical UART (TX/RX on P1.02/P1.03 @115200) which needs an external serial adapter; there is no onboard USB-UART bridge and no USB CDC in the app. I2C1 SCL P0.27 / SDA P0.26. ESB radio is available for split-keyboard half-to-half; BLE HID uses the on-chip S140.
